mapper.select: SELECT id, facility_name, facility_type, address, contract_power_kw, created_at, ST_Y(facility_center::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(facility_center::geometry) AS longitude FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, facility_name, facility_type, address, contract_power_kw, created_at, ST_Y(facility_center::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(facility_center::geometry) AS longitude FROM company_facilities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_facilities (company_id, facility_name, facility_type, address, contract_power_kw, facility_center, created_at) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{dto.facilityName}, #{dto.facilityType}, #{dto.address}, #{dto.contractPowerKw}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude}), 4326), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE company_facilities SET facility_name = #{facilityName}, facility_type = #{facilityType}, address = #{address}, contract_power_kw = #{contractPowerKw}, facility_center = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) WHERE id = #{id}
